item.title: State officials debunk viral worn down bridge video, but what condition are other La. bridges in?
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A viral video shared widely on social media sparked concern across Louisiana after captions claimed that the worn-down bridge depicted in the video was the Atchafalaya Basin Bridge. Louisiana Department of Transportation says the video does not depict a bridge in Louisiana, but in Florida.Federal data does show there are bridges in Louisiana that are in need of repair or replacement. item.title: Westdale Middle counselor placed on administrative leave; allegedly inappropriately messaged minor
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A Westdale Middle School counselor was placed on administrative leave Thursday after allegations of him inappropriately messaging a minor.A post on social media accused Quinton Dixon of messaging a minor student inappropriately. item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS - A vehicle crashed through a home on Springfield Road and Fore Road in Denham Springs, officials said.Videos and photos from the scene showed holes in the property with the car fully inside the house. item.title: Judge denies state's motion in lawsuit challenging law banning sex change procedures for minors
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A law banning services, treatments, and procedures that alter the sex characteristics of a minor took effect in 2024, soon after a lawsuit was filed against the state on behalf of five Louisiana transgender youth and their families. Nicholas Hite, senior attorney with Lambda Legal, says he and his team have every intention to take the case to trial."What we are asking is that even if this law is on the books, because it is unconstitutional, it can't be enforced," Hite said. item.title: Dunham goes on the road to beat Catholic
item.description: BATON ROUGE - The Dunham boys basketball team went on the road to beat Catholic on Thursday night.The Tigers jumped out to a 41-25 lead the half, and then cruised to a 74-62 win.Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSU baseball hosts annual First Pitch Banquet
item.description: BATON ROUGE - With the baseball season under a month away, the LSU baseball team held its annual First Pitch Banquet on Thursday night.Before the banquet, WBRZ Sports Director Michael Cauble interviewed LSU baseball coach Jay Johnson.The Tigers open the 2026 season February 13 against Milwaukee.Permalink| Comments
